en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town nestled in hilly terrain. In the foreground are many steep-roofed houses. Dominating the middle ground is a prominent church with a tall spire and an adjoining walled churchyard or complex. Behind the town rise open fields and a forested hill with a small structure or monument visible on its summit. In the sky area at the upper left, printed text reads "Altenberg i. Erzgeb."
